title: Custom Function Creator (3 Stages)
description:
Build custom functions across 3 stages:
1. Define a function say_hello() that prints "Hello, Learner!". Call say_hello().
2. Define a function double_val(n) that returns n * 2. Call and print double_val(5).
3. Define a function calc_total(price, tax=5) that returns price + tax. Call and print calc_total(100) with default tax.
